loginPage.heading: Welcome back
loginPage.taglineDescription: Organise recipes, plan menus and track your pantry - all in one place.

registerPage.heading: Register
registerPage.taglineDescription: Create an account to save recipes, build menus and track your pantry.

forgotPasswordPage.heading: Forgot password
forgotPasswordPage.subheading: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPasswordPage.taglineDescription: We'll email you a link to get back into your account.
forgotPasswordPage.submittedMessage: If an account with that email exists and is verified, we've sent a password reset link to it.
forgotPasswordPage.submittedHint: No email is sent if the address isn't registered, or if it hasn't been verified yet.

resetPasswordPage.heading: Reset password
resetPasswordPage.subheading: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPasswordPage.taglineDescription: Set a new password to get back into your account.
resetPasswordPage.invalidMessage: This password reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one from the login page.

verifyEmailPage.taglineDescription: Just a moment while we confirm your email address.
verifyEmailPage.successMessage: Your email is verified - password reset is now available for your account.
verifyEmailPage.invalidMessage: This verification link is no longer valid. You can request a new one from Settings while logged in.
